# Test fixtures

- `readsb-sample.jsonl`: synthetic readsb JSON-port output, generated by
  `gen_readsb_jsonl.py` (see its docstring).
- `raw/`: real receiver captures, used by `test_rawtools.sh` and handy for
  `skycue-start.sh replay-raw`. They are third-party data, committed unchanged
  under their own licences; this repository is private and does not
  redistribute them. Do not ship them in release bundles.

## raw/modes-120s.csv.gz

- Origin: https://github.com/junzis/pyModeS, file
  `scripts/data/airsquitter_2026-07-13_120s.csv.gz` (renamed here).
- Licence: GPL-3.0 (the pyModeS repository's licence).
- Content: 120 s of 1090 MHz Mode S traffic (European, 2026-07-13), 176,612
  messages (118,059 short, 14 hex digits; 58,553 long, 28 hex digits); readsb
  decodes positions for 248 aircraft from it.
- Line format: `epoch_seconds.fraction,HEX`, no header, gzip-compressed.
  First line: `1783963099.005369,5F406A936F50F0`.
- Decoding positions needs a receiver location near the traffic, e.g.
  `--lat 52.0 --lon 4.5 --max-range 500` for readsb.
- sha256: `fa433eb8dc2ec9cf6ebd40c1bf0a095ae753960d5e8c42ae6da15cc28eb3baea`

## raw/uat-sample.txt.gz

- Origin: https://github.com/flightaware/dump978, file `sample-data.txt.gz`
  (renamed here).
- Licence: BSD-2-Clause (the dump978 repository's licence).
- Content: 1,143 dump978 raw UAT messages: 439 downlink, 704 uplink.
- Line format: `-<hex>;` (downlink) or `+<hex>;` (uplink), no timestamps,
  gzip-compressed. skycue-rawplay paces such files at 10 lines/s.
  First line: `-00a66ef135445d525a0c0519119021204800;`.
- sha256: `86248797f4334a134ccf4349dabf800a7054d698828b88838dc7950a99f9ae24`
